items.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023
items.q: My first big time gig was playing lead trumpet with Brenda Lee at a club in Jackson, Mississippi.

ctx.x: the Jimmy Dorsey band. I was the Tommy Dorsey, you know it was mostly the Dorsey brothers’ library in the book. And so I saved up enough money to pay my tuition and first month’s rent.

There’s an anecdote in your bio, or this was an interview you did with somebody, I’m going to read it for a moment: “My first big time gig was playing lead trumpet with Brenda Lee at a club in Jackson, Mississippi. The gig was six nights a week. I always passed out after playing a big, long high C in the middle of the show. I had to hitchhike back and forth to Jackson every night. I was going to class every day in the morning. So every night from two to six AM I was waiting on the side of the road for a ride. The…
Yes. My father told me if you’re going to hitchhike wear a suit. So I had to wear a suit to the gig anyway so — but nobody picked me up until the sun came out.
